scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration cross-checks were actually run; arbitrary alphabet/order are established by a graph proof, not inferred from experiments. No independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic words at deficit exactly one are classified; balanced-edge rigidity is proved generally, while exhaustive checks are finite and no independent scientific audit was conducted. Classical puncture/insertion and de Bruijn count are cited as prior art. Novelty can be affected by unindexed characterizations of modified sequences.
title: One-symbol puncturing rigidity of de Bruijn cycles and the complete near-universal census
